prior_exposure: Read existing post-hoc NO VOTAN audit; institutional distinction present-not-voting known but exact XML literal equivalence unresolved. Do not treat source found before this prereg as independent prospective discovery.

A.question: Can an official Senate technical schema/manual or two contemporaneous linked institutional originals independently establish that the literal XML `NO VOTAN` in the 2025 nominal votes means 'senador presente que expresamente no vota', rather than absence/abstention/uncoded category?
A.unit: A specific XML field value in Senate vote document for XV legislature
A.outcome: Existence of unambiguous official literal-to-semantics mapping

B.H1: A first-party machine format specification explicitly maps literal NO VOTAN to presence-but-not-voting or an equivalent unambiguous technical category.
B.H0: No such first-party definition located in bounded search; meaning stays UNKNOWN.
B.H_other: General official page describes non-voting while technical XML field aggregates multiple statuses or differs across versions.

query_plan: site:senado.es xml votaciones nominales esquema no votan
Senado España documentación XML votaciones no votan esquema
sources_priority: Official Senado XV data dictionary or XSD/OpenData developer docs
Official Senate session nominal vote & attendance aligned for one documented plenary
C.positive_accept: Literal exact-match plus referenced field/version and official definition, directly viewed in source; capture URL and bounded quote in result.
C.negative_accept: Document search outcomes and lack of accessible schema/nominal mapping; do not claim absence proves nonexistence.
C.falsifier: Primary documentation or session contradicting assumed equivalence.
C.stop: At most 5 bounded targeted queries plus 3 primary-source visits; do not expand to repeated near-duplicate queries without material leads.

D.method: web search and direct read of primary institution sources; if accessible documents are PDF, inspect a page screenshot; record retrieval limits and date; no program execution or private originals.

E.execution: Only actual web results count; no independent test if no source mapping.
E.report: Link source URLs, what observed, outcome and negative sources.

F.adversarial: Search-result snippets and generic explanatory webpage cannot establish XML schema. Name of category may appear in report but not coded literal. Misclassification may cause unfair individual scoring; remain fail-closed.

G.external_repetition: Not assumed. A single Senate website is not independent replication. Original XML + official schema would be technical cross-check, not causal validation.

H.update: If no source or ambiguous source, NO_VOTAN semantic mapping remains UNKNOWN; introduce no scoring claim.

J.decision_rule: Document evidence or STOP_R5 on semantic claim; no duplicate audit or broaden scope to political behavior without separate authorization.
